entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's start up Featherman Seeker.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, but before we start, there's[n]something I think you should know.
What is it?
Let's just play.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, so listen up.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just hold on a sec.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I checked the manual, and it says the[n]story in this game is different from[n]the original TV show.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Something about trying to become[n]the sixth Phoenix Ranger...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I don't know much about the TV series,[n]but this looks like a game you can really[n]sink your teeth into!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's become a Phoenix Ranger!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Doesn't it sound exciting? We should[n]totally become a Phoenix Ranger!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: By the way, haven't you read that[n]secret technique book?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It makes the input commands less difficult,[n]which makes the game easier, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, should we use the trick? It will lessen[n]the difficulty of the input commands.
Use the technique
Play the game normally

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, you're fired up! All right, go for it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Makes sense, since you've learned[n]how to. All right, let's do this!
First, remember the commands[n]as displayed on the screen.
Then enter the commands accurately[n]within the time limit.

entries.speaker: Narration
entries.en: As the threat of doom draws near,[n]a new power spreads its wings...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, they really know how to get you[n]pumped up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is this... a lab? That person in front of[n]the computer looks like a scientist.

entries.speaker: Woman in White Lab Coat
entries.en: ...You're awake already. That's a[n]promising sign.

entries.speaker: Woman in White Lab Coat
entries.en: My name is... Well, just call me Osagiri.[n]I've been put in charge of your training.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Welcome to my space laboratory. You are[n]the strongest fighter that I've created yet.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: We will now commence your training.[n]Endure it, and you will acquire power[n]equaling that of the Phoenix Rangers.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Since today is your first day, we'll use the[n]simulator. Don't worry about passing or[n]failing, just show me what you can do.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Training, huh... I guess you can't become[n]a hero if you don't put in the effort.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Let's begin with a warm up. Try[n]controlling your strength as instructed.

entries.speaker: Narration
entries.en: Pigeon lands on Earth... to engage in[n]his first real battle against an Aberrant!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess we've moved on from Osagiri's[n]space lab. This looks like an urban area[n]on Earth.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Pigeon, can you hear me? This is Osagiri.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: From now on, I'll communicate with you[n]through this com device in your helmet.[n]I'll provide you with support from the lab.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: I'm getting readings of an Infinibug a bit[n]north of you. Please refer to the data[n]I sent you before you go into battle.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: And remember that this is not a[n]simulation, but a real battle. Failure[n]is not an option.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: As I said before, you will act alone until you[n]are sufficiently capable. Your value is being[n]tested as you put your life on the line.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sending a trainee into battle against a real[n]enemy? Man, Osagiri isn't just tough, she's[n]reckless...

entries.speaker: Aberrant
entries.en: Brrring! I can sense a connection...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What the— Is that a walking phone booth?

entries.speaker: Aberrant
entries.en: I hearrr humans communicating!

entries.speaker: Aberrant
entries.en: I'm going to rrrandomly rrreconnect[n]the ends to confuse everrrybody!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Target located. Pigeon, you must[n]exterminate it. May this fight[n]contribute to your growth.

entries.speaker: Aberrant
entries.en: Who are you? Why are you drrressed like[n]a Featherman!? You'd betterrr stay out of[n]my way!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Here it comes! Get your controller ready!

entries.speaker: Aberrant
entries.en: I am Phoneternum! Hear me rrring![n]In the name of Zylam, I will defeat you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The city will be our battlefield. Let's[n]defeat the Aberrant this time!

entries.speaker: Narration
entries.en: Fighting battle after battle, Pigeon only[n]grows stronger. He dives head first into a[n]confrontation with the next Aberrant...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Osagiri here. I'm getting readings of an[n]Infinibug from inside that factory. I'll[n]send you the data just like last time.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: By the way, this battle marks the end[n]of your training. You'll graduate from[n]trainee status... If you survive, that is.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is where we show them what Pigeon is[n]all about. Let's win this battle and graduate[n]from trainee status!

entries.speaker: Aberrant
entries.en: Bzzz! How did you discover our human[n]bloodmeal manufacturing plant!?

entries.speaker: Aberrant
entries.en: Only the officers are suppozzzed to[n]know about this place!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Over there! That must be our enemy!

entries.speaker: Aberrant
entries.en: Mosquiternum is the name. And you[n]muzzzt be the rumored Infinibug hunter!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I see the factory up ahead. We've gotta[n]exterminate the Aberrant for sure this[n]time!

entries.speaker: Mosquiternum
entries.en: Mosquiternum is the name. And you[n]muzzzt be the rumored Infinibug hunter!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Here it comes! Get your controller ready!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Impressive! You exhibit flawless control.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Let's see how you do with the next[n]challenge.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: ...I believe you can do better. Let's try[n]that challenge once more.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Perhaps you weren't sufficiently[n]prepared. Let's try a different challenge.

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Brrring! Taste my Rrradio Wave Beam!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah! Nice dodge!

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Impossible! You managed to dodge my[n]attack... You're no ordinary human!

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: How about this? Coily Corrrd!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is bad. Pigeon's caught in the cord[n]and can't move!

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Hya ha ha ha! What a marrrvelous view!

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Now you have no chance of dodging[n]my Rrradio Wave Beam!

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Hee hee hee! Rrright in the kisserrr!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Pigeon? Come in Pigeon! Answer me...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No... You died...

entries.speaker: Mosquiternum
entries.en: You're not getting outta here alive![n]Bloodzzzucker Needle!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's take him on! Feathernix Saber!

entries.speaker: Mosquiternum
entries.en: Bzz! You saw my needle coming? It's[n]like you already knew my moves...

entries.speaker: Mosquiternum
entries.en: Bzz... Bzzz... Glory to Zzzylam! Bzz...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right! We beat Mosquiternum!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But this guy said something weird before[n]he died, just like the last one...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: You've done well. Very well, indeed...[n]Let's meet up in front of the factory.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Osagiri's coming to see us in person?[n]You think she's going to give us a[n]trainee graduation gift by hand?

entries.speaker: Mosquiternum
entries.en: You mizzzed! Were you even aiming?[n]Now your blood is mine!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Pigeon? Come in Pigeon! Answer me...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No... You died...

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Here we go! Rrring! Rrradio Wave Beam!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Cut the cord, quick! We have to escape!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Well done, Pigeon. You've come a long[n]way. You can meet with the Feathermen...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: ...if you can defeat me, that is. I want to[n]see the results of your training with my[n]own eyes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess this is our graduation exam.[n]In which case... we have to win!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: And no holding back. Come at me[n]with intent to kill. It's the only way I[n]can measure your true skills.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is she serious...? Well, I guess we don't[n]have time for questions! Blaster Shot!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Incredible... Your strength is far greater[n]than I initially projected...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: I don't think you're showing your full[n]potential. Let's repeat that challenge.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Your technique could use some[n]fine-tuning... but you may proceed[n]to the next challenge.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Good! We escaped the cord and[n]dodged the beam!

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Wh-Whaaat!? How did you do that!?

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Brrrahahaha! Too slow! You're completely[n]outmatched. Now I've got you!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Pigeon? Come in Pigeon! Answer me...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No... You died...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Ngh...! Nice... shot. Hehe... You've[n]exceeded my expectations. I accept[n]my defeat.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yes! Pigeon wins!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Amazing... Simply incredible! You've[n]turned out exactly as I hoped you would!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: An easy dodge! Now it's my turn!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Uh-oh... Pigeon's out cold...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: This next challenge will be the last.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Battle simulator, start!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, the scenery changed. Hmmm...[n]Is this a waste disposal facility?

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: You will be facing an Aberrant from[n]Zylam, the Infinibug army planning[n]to take over Earth.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Its name is Scrapeternum... a powerful[n]Aberrant born of a parasite that fed on[n]scrap metal.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: But I know you can defeat it. I have[n]faith in you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So this training is preparing us for[n]real combat. All right, let's get the Aberrant!

entries.speaker: Scrapeternum
entries.en: Clangity clang! I'm Scrapeternum, the[n]scrap metal eating Aberrant, clang!

entries.speaker: Scrapeternum
entries.en: There's too many people on Earth, clang![n]I'm going to squash them flat to make it[n]a more comfortable place to live, clang!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...This guy's pretty chipper about being[n]a threat to the planet's safety, huh?

entries.speaker: Scrapeternum
entries.en: You dare stand in my way, clang?[n]I'll flatten you out, clang!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Here it comes! Get your controller ready!

entries.speaker: Scrapeternum
entries.en: Take this! Compression Press!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Pigeon, now's your chance! Your[n]opponent's guard is down!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now, let's finish this off! Aerial Slash!
This is where we're getting readings of[n]the Infinibug!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Who is that? Wait... I see five silhouettes...

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: Here we are! The Feathermen have[n]arrived!

entries.speaker: Blue Swan
entries.en: But what's going on? I don't see any[n]Aberrants...

entries.speaker: Yellow Owl
entries.en: What about that gray one there?

entries.speaker: Pink Argus
entries.en: But that looks like a Featherman...

entries.speaker: Black Falcon
entries.en: It can't be... The Infinibug readings[n]are coming from that Featherman!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, it's the Feathermen!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But something about this feels off...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Do you hear them, Pigeon? They think[n]you're the Aberrant. Are you really just[n]going to sit there and let them kill you...?

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: Are you a Phoenix Ranger? Explain[n]yourself!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is getting weird... but the game isn't[n]giving us a choice.

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: Hm... So you're going to fight? You[n]don't seem like an Aberrant to me...

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: But if you're challenging us, we will[n]not falter! Let's go! Feather Phoenix!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's fight with this! Flame Bazooka!

entries.speaker: Scrapeternum
entries.en: Hm!? How could this cheeky little brat[n]dodge my attack? Clang it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is our chance! Wind Punch!

entries.speaker: Scrapeternum
entries.en: Hahaha! Bullseye, clang! You shouldn't[n]have underestimated me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's payback time! Wind Punch!

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Gah! H-How do you know... my weak[n]spots...? Wait! You'rrre not...!

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Grrr... Glorrry to Zylam!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right! We beat Phoneternum!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But I wonder what he was trying to say...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: That was impressive, Pigeon. But it seems[n]you've not fully awakened yet. There is[n]power within you that still lies dormant...

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: You should try to learn to access that[n]power. It will prove to be of great benefit[n]to you.

entries.speaker: Phoneternum
entries.en: Gya ha ha ha! You missed! And you've[n]left yourself wide open! Rrradio Wave[n]Beam!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Pigeon? Come in Pigeon! Answer me...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No... You died...

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: Urgh... Such power! How could we be[n]defeated?

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Hehehehe... Ahahaha! The experiment[n]has been a success!

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: Yes, we managed to strike first!

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Pigeon!? No! It can't end like this...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No... You died...

entries.speaker: Osagiri?
entries.en: Everything has gone according to plan...[n]Now the executive seat is mine!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Executive seat? What is she talking[n]about...?

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: Gr... Just who are you!?

entries.speaker: Osagiri?
entries.en: I am Alya, one of Zylam's officers. There[n]was never an Osagiri.

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Your Phoenix Ranger 'training' was only a[n]cover. This was an experiment to create an[n]Aberrant who could fight the Feathermen.

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Pigeon, you are an Aberrant, created by[n]infesting a human with parasitic Infinibugs,[n]then irradiating it with Feathernix Waves.

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: I only made you fight those Aberrants[n]in order to make you strong enough to[n]defeat the Feathermen.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I knew something was off, but I wasn't[n]expecting a twist like that...

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Now, Gray Pigeon! Finish off the[n]Feathermen once and for all, and[n]let us claim victory!

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: Gray Pigeon, listen to me! We understand...[n]You may be an Aberrant, but you are not[n]evil. There is justice in your heart!

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: What are you waiting for, Pigeon? Destroy[n]them, now!

entries.speaker: Narration
entries.en: It was then that Pigeon's heart screamed[n]out for justice... Alya was his true enemy!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa! Pigeon's facing Alya now!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's Osagiri... I mean Alya, Zylam's[n]leader!

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: I suppose the experiment was a failure...[n]Looks like I'll just have to fix you! Take this![n]Skull Rod!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've got to take down Alya! Feather[n]Phoenix!

entries.speaker: Scrapeternum
entries.en: I can't... believe I lost... Glory to[n]Zylam! ...clang...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh yeah! A big win!

entries.speaker: Scrapeternum
entries.en: You can't hit me, clang! Now it's my turn!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Aww... We lost.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, we're back in the laboratory.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: The simulation is complete. Now you[n]know what fighting an Aberrant is like.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: From now on, you will be known as[n]Gray Pigeon.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Continue your training by going on solo[n]missions. You will meet the Feathermen[n]only when you gain sufficient strength.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: You could become the sixth Featherman...[n]You may even surpass them.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: No one would be able to defeat you... No one.

entries.speaker: Osagiri
entries.en: Well, you must be tired. Here, take this[n]nap capsule and get some rest...

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Ugh... Do you dare defy your creator,[n]foolish Aberrant? Fine... I won't try to[n]fix you. I'll just dispose of you instead!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Did you see that? She just pressed some[n]kind of switch!

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Hehe, I've activated the time bomb I had[n]implanted inside you. Soon, you and the[n]entire planet will be blown to smithereens!

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: I've gathered all the data I need, so you're[n]no longer of any use to me. I'll just be sure[n]to make my next Aberrant more obedient.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Man, she fights dirty... Isn't there anything[n]we can do?

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: It looks like you lost consciousness. Were[n]my attacks too fast? I'll be tweaking your[n]brain to correct your insubordination.

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Next time you wake up, you will be my[n]obedient slave... Hehehe... Hahahahaha!

entries.speaker: Narration
entries.en: Doom was almost certain... But the justice[n]in Pigeon's heart was not ready to give up!

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: I should be going... Hm?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, something's happening to Pigeon!

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: What...? This energy emanating from[n]you... Is this your full awakening!?

entries.speaker: Narration
entries.en: The time has come! Awaken your[n]dormant powers, Gray Pigeon!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: O-Okay! Let's awaken Pigeon's powers!

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Wha!? Are we... in my space lab...?

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: I see... That was Feather Dimension, the[n]ability to transport someone to another[n]dimension.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I get it! You can let the bomb blow up with[n]just the two of you here... Impressive move,[n]Pigeon.

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Hm. Your performance far exceeded[n]my expectations. I must accept defeat...

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: I had assumed there were no humans left[n]with a sense of justice. That was why I chose[n]a human as a base material to create you...

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: But it would seem that things never go[n]as planned when it matters the most...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's over. So Pigeon's sacrifice saved[n]the Feathermen... No, it saved Earth.

entries.speaker: Narration
entries.en: Meanwhile, back on Earth...

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: He showed incredible courage in his final[n]moments. He could have joined us in our[n]fight...

entries.speaker: Red Eagle
entries.en: Thank you, Gray Pigeon. The justice in[n]your heart saved us in the end. We will[n]never forget your name...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey! Don't screw up now! You still[n]have a chance to win, so make it work!

entries.speaker: Alya
entries.en: Huh. You surprised me for a second, but I[n]guess your awakening was a failure. Time[n]for you to fly off to the next life. Goodbye.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Pigeon!!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're finished training. So what do you[n]think? Can you become a Phoenix Ranger?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We won today's battle. So what do you[n]think? Can you become a Phoenix Ranger?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You got a game over, huh...[n]What a depressing screen.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You completed Featherman Seeker.[n]Pigeon became a Phoenix Ranger after[n]all, didn't he...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You got a game over, huh...[n]What a depressing screen.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That game was stimulating to the[n]brain. It must have buffed up your[n][stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That game was stimulating to the[n]brain. It must have buffed up your[n][stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That game was stimulating to the[n]brain. It must have buffed up your[n][stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The secret technique book helped, huh?[n]You're always looking for the most efficient[n]way to do things. I admire that about you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, we failed, but it was still stimulating[n]to the brain. It must have buffed up your[n][stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I wish there was a way to make this[n]game a little easier...
If only there was a way to[n]lower the game's difficulty...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't you have a book on secret[n]techniques? Maybe you should[n]try giving it a read sometime.
Now that I think about it, I have[n]a book on secret techniques...[n]Maybe I should read it sometime.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is it too tough for you? We'll just[n]have to try again next time!
This is pretty difficult... I'll[n]have to give it another try later.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm sure you're tired after how into it[n]you were getting. Let's stop here for[n]today, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That took a really long time...[n]We should probably stop playing[n]games for now, don't you think?
